title: Supplemental materials for "A Pilot Study of Visual, Vocal, and Verbal Markers of PTSD"
description:
Browse the analysis reports online at https://jmgirard.github.io/pilot-ptsd-markers/. This record is the archived, citable copy.

Deidentified data, analysis code (Quarto source files), and rendered analysis reports supporting the article "A Pilot Study of Visual, Vocal, and Verbal Markers of PTSD". The data/ folder contains verbal (LIWC-22 and sentiment), vocal (prosody and voice quality), and visual (facial action unit and head pose) features extracted from two trauma-related speaking tasks completed by trauma-exposed adults with and without PTSD, together with the model covariates, and a codebook. These files reproduce every model, table, and figure in the analysis reports. Reports cover Bayesian mixed models for each modality, behavioral feature descriptives (Table S1), and sample demographics (Table 1).

The video, audio, and transcript data contain identifiable protected health information and are not included.

Data and rendered reports are licensed under CC BY 4.0; source code is licensed under the MIT License (see LICENSE and LICENSE-CC-BY.md in the archive).
